## 5. Acceptance Criteria

All of the following must pass before Phase 5 is complete:

- [ ] `docsync sync --spaces DOCS,ENG` routes files by `space_mappings`; files mapped to `API` are SKIPPED
- [ ] `docsync sync --spaces DOCS` with legacy `space_key: DOCS` config works identically to baseline
- [ ] `docsync sync --spaces BADKEY` with no matching mapping emits a WARNING and syncs 0 files (no error)
- [ ] `docsync sync --spaces ""` raises `BadParameter` before touching config
- [ ] Pre-flight failure on unauthorized space → exit code 1 (no files touched)
- [ ] `--continue-on-error` + one failing space → that space skipped, others synced, exit code 0
- [ ] Existing TC-001 tests all pass unchanged (backward compat)
- [ ] `pytest --cov` shows >= 80% coverage on new modules
